description: Delete everything held about a case, immediately and permanently. The record is removed, not flagged, and it cannot be recovered afterwards — not by us either. This is the promise the privacy policy makes, and it needs no account. It does need the delete token issued when the case was created: reading a case and destroying it are deliberately different capabilities.

delete_token.description: The one-time token returned by check_medical_bill. Deleting is a separate capability from reading on purpose: a case link can end up in a browser history or a forwarded message, and whoever finds it should not be able to destroy the record.

name: delete_case
title: Delete a case
